definitions.explanation: Without covering or protection; figuratively, without pretense.

examples.japanese: {赤|あか}ちゃんが{裸|はだか}で{遊|あそ}んでいる。
{裸|はだか}の{付|つ}き{合|あ}いで{友情|ゆうじょう}を{深|ふか}めた。
examples.english: We deepened our friendship through frank, open interaction.
examples.notes: 裸の付き合い literally 'naked association' means honest, open relationship

examples.japanese: {裸|はだか}の{木|き}が{冬|ふゆ}の{空|そら}に{立|た}っている。
examples.english: Bare trees stand against the winter sky.

notes:
Can be used literally (without clothes) or figuratively (exposed, honest, bare).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{裸|はだか}になる (to become naked, to strip down)
・{裸|はだか}の{付|つ}き{合|あ}い (frank, heart-to-heart relationship)
・{裸|はだか}一{貫|かん} (starting with nothing but oneself)
・{裸|はだか}の{王様|おうさま} (The Emperor's New Clothes)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{裸足|はだし} (barefoot)
・{裸眼|らがん} (naked eye, without glasses)
・{素裸|すっぱだか} (stark naked - emphatic)
